body.problemStatement: Municipal solid waste collection is inefficient, with mixed waste reaching landfills due to poor source segregation and static, non-optimized collection routes that waste fuel and manpower.

body.title: AI-Based Pothole & Road Damage Detection System
body.problemStatement: Municipal road maintenance relies on manual visual surveys that are slow, inconsistent and cover only a fraction of the road network each year. The department needs an automated way to continuously detect potholes, cracks and surface damage across the city road network so that repair crews can be dispatched proactively instead of reactively responding to complaints.
body.desiredTechnology: Computer Vision, IoT Sensors, GIS Mapping, Deep Learning
body.outcomesExpected: Automated, geo-tagged detection of road defects at city scale with a prioritized repair dashboard for maintenance crews.

body.challengeTitle: AI-Based Pothole & Road Damage Detection System
body.summary: Deploy our production dashcam + deep-learning defect-detection pipeline, already proven with Pune Municipal Corporation, across the department's vehicle fleet with a prioritized repair dashboard.
body.proposedApproach: Mount low-cost cameras on existing municipal and sanitation vehicles, run on-device pre-filtering with cloud-based CNN scoring, geo-tag every defect and expose a GeoJSON feed plus a repair-prioritization dashboard for maintenance crews.
